source_snapshot.items: System power on, power sequencing, power cycling and reboot testing
source_snapshot.procedure: For 8h record lspci/FW, shutdown and repeat.

old_problem: Eight hours conflicts with 30-minute metadata; shutdown/reboot/power-reset semantics and FW comparison/recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: ED-06/18 require exact cycle semantics and OFF-ON-OS-ready evidence; ED-14 forbids replacing eight hours with a short smoke test.

test_case.purpose: Repeat the approved power-cycle type for the authoritative duration and verify complete OFF-ON-OS-ready plus stable PCIe/FW identity each cycle.
test_case.test_command: After approval capture baseline; perform one authorized cycle at a time, prove OFF then ON then OS-ready, collect normalized lspci/FW/log deltas and stop on first anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: Every cycle completes; topology/FW remain identical and no new error appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Reboot is not AC/DC evidence; 30 minutes cannot replace eight hours without owner revision.
test_case.recovery: Stop cycling, use OOB recovery, preserve failed-cycle evidence and restore approved power state.

source_conflict.reason: Eight hours conflicts with 30 minutes and reboot semantics.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Approve duration, cycle type/count/dwell, oracle and recovery.

project_authority: Cycle mechanism and duration are project-specific.
